quest.title: Return From the Mysterious Realm
quest.description: Returning to Sumeru, you and Paimon run into some old friends...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x10, Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. We haven't been back to the Akademiya in a while. It hasn't changed much, has it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, since we've got some time... Wanna go to the House of Daena? Paimon wants to do some reading!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me? Who are you, and what have you done with Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hah, so you noticed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, you're too late! The Paimon you know and love is no more!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're looking at Paimon Plus! A new and improved treasure trove of travel know-how!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon Plus would like to find some new books to peruse. A gracious Traveler like yourself wouldn't leave her companionless on her quest, right?

choices.text: I'm kind of afraid to see what would happen if I refused...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, c'mon! This way...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, hey! It's Collei, and... Cyrus!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wonder what's going on... Let's go see!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And the books? Abandoning the quest already?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Well...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know what they say... Learning is a lifelong quest!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Which means there's always another chance to read a book. But, you never know when the next chance to reunite with an old friend will come along!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure, sure, whatever you say.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: #Hm? {NICKNAME}, Paimon? You're back in Sumeru?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Hoho! Hello, you two. It's been a while. Looking to spend time with some old friends?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, yep! We saw some familiar faces, so we came to say hi!

choices.text: Exactly. How could I forget the old man who lives next to Zaha Hadi.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Hoho, excuse you, associating me with that woman!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: And, if you're going to remember me that way, you should at least mention my tomato growing skills!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: So, he's mad about the "Zaha Hadi" part and not the "old man" part...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pfft...!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon's glad to see you in such good spirits, Cyrus. Must mean things are all good here in Sumeru.

choices.text: Apologies, Sir Cyrus.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Ah, well, it's quite alright. I'm not the type to take offense at that kind of thing, haha!

response.speaker: #Collei & Paimon & {NICKNAME}
response.text: (You definitely are...!)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (You definitely are...!)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (You definitely are...!)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, what were you and Collei chatting about just now?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Ah, that... Well, it was quite a spontaneous meeting!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: I was leaving the Sage's office when I spotted Collei in conversation with a Mahamata, and it looked serious.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: I thought something bad might have happened, so I hurried over as soon as the conversation ended.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: But, as it turns out, our Collei is moving up in the world. The Akademiya even hired her as a consultant!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow! That's incredible!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh... It's nothing, really...

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Look at that! So humble. Takes after me, she does!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Not at all, not at all... No, wait! I didn't mean that to sound like I don't think you're humble, Mr. Cyrus, because of course you are, I just... uh...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Uh oh, Collei's so nervous she's sweating. I should help her out...)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Anyway, what are you a consultant for, exactly?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh, well, I wouldn't even call myself a consultant. I'm just helping out...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Now that the new semester has started, a lot of students and scholars are doing field work for their research.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But, it can be dangerous for those who don't have a lot of experience in the wilds.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: So, the Akademiya is planning to establish an agency that provides guidance on outdoor survival and rescue for people who need it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Paimon gets it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, you're here to explain rainforest survival as a representative of the Forest Rangers!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Yeah, pretty much.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Of course, when it comes to tips on deciphering mechanisms or defeating monsters, that's for people who are far more senior than me to handle.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Ah, and speaking of which... Since we're short on manpower, the person in charge at the Akademiya said we're still accepting newcomers.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: If you're interested, you're welcome to join and share your insights.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: #Ah, seizing the moment. Well done, Collei! Recruiting someone as capable as {NICKNAME} is a great idea!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Oh, and just between the four of us... The Akademiya has set aside a generous amount of funding for this project.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *gasp*

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ahem! Well, since Collei's thrown her hat in the ring, we should help out too! Whaddaya say, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, as we all know, I'm nothing if not helpful.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Great!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: We're all supposed to meet up in Aaru Village later, so I guess we'll regroup there!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Phew... I was kinda worried, since Master Tighnari isn't around to help this time. But, now I feel much better...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Have faith. You don't need anyone's help to do a great job.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Even if you don't trust the Akademiya's eye for talent, you can trust ours for sure!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: And mine, of course! I have as good an eye for people as I do for tomatoes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, there you have it!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Hehe... Thanks, everyone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, speaking of Tighnari, how are things with him and the others?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Good, thanks! All the Forest Rangers are doing great.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh, but Master Tighnari did mention that Cyno and Sethos were heading to Gandharva Ville... I'm not sure if it's for work or something else...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, knowing them... Could just be to play some cards...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Hmm... I'm not sure. Apparently, Sethos is bringing someone else with him too.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But, with my Akademiya commitment, I didn't have time to ask for more details...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh, well now Paimon's curious. Should we go check things out, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why not? It's been a while since we've dropped in to say hi.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: That's true, and I'm sure they've missed you.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Now, that is how it should be between friends, getting together to play cards or enjoy a meal. Yet, here I am, stuck with Naphis who only ever calls to talk about research...

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Well, I won't delay your reunion any longer. Until next time!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Goodbye, Mr. Cyrus. Take care!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Alright, I should probably get going too.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: See you later, guys! Come find me in Aaru Village when you're ready!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure thing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe. Looking forward to seeing you shine, Collei!

choices.text: I couldn't help making a joke at your expense.
Exactly. How could I forget Naphis' assistant.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Hah, you must be mistaken!

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Unless, of course, you mean his "project collaborator." Because that is far more accurate.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Naphis, that old coot, should thank his lucky stars he has me on his team!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Which is something he'd never have the courage to say to his face...

choices.text: You've got me there. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tighnari's place... Tighnari's place... Ah, here it is!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cyno, Sethos! Looks like the whole gang's here! ...Oh, and Layla's here too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, oh... She doesn't look too good. Did something happen?

choices.text: Hi everyone, it's been a while.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: #Ah, Paimon, {NICKNAME}. It's good to see you.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I'd welcome you like a proper host, but I'm a bit busy at the moment. Apologies.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No worries. This seems serious.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Ah, no need to look that worried.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: My observations indicate Miss Layla's condition has improved quite a bit.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: There's no danger to her mind. She's just fatigued and needs some rest.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Excuse me for a moment while I blend some calming incense. I'll let you two explain the situation.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Alright.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: What happened was, Sethos and a few members of the Temple of Silence rescued Layla, who was out in the desert trapped in a state of delirium.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She had to be "rescued"? That sounds bad...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: That's all you're gonna say about it, Cyno? I mean, we don't want people jumping to conclusions.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: That's all I can say about it. The person involved is unable to explain what happened to her, so we're limited in what we know.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Ugh... Sorry. My head... still dizzy...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: The moons... The moons... Exactly how many are there...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (The moons!?)

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: She's been repeating that phrase over and over again, but she can't seem to remember what happened to her.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: We tried a few things back at the Temple of Silence, but we couldn't recover her memories.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Her symptoms are kind of similar to researchers in the Satyavada Life state, so we brought her to Tighnari to see if our veteran Forest Watcher had any other ideas.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Tighnari is pretty much our last option, so let's hope he can help.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: The good news is, even if restoring her memory is a no go, we can help with the headache at least. Djer was in a similar state when we found him, delirious and mumbling to himself, but he's more or less back to normal now.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Ah, sorry. I should give you some context first, huh...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: We should let Miss Layla get some rest. Come with me, you two, and I'll introduce you to the other "victim" of this incident.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Good idea. I'll wait for Tighnari here and keep an eye on our patient.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Alright, then! This way.

choices.text: Is everything okay here...?

dialogues.speaker: Djer
dialogues.text: *sigh* Who did the Ajilenakh Nut offend... I just don't get it...

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Hey, Djer! Still musing about Ajilenakh Nuts, huh? Want me to have Cyno come over and tell some jokes? Might help distract you!

dialogues.speaker: Djer
dialogues.text: NO! No need. I'm done.

choices.text: I like jokes.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Don't encourage him!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Well, sorry for interrupting the Ajilenakh talk, buddy. Next time, just say... "Ah, gee. Hey! Knock!"

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Agh!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold on, hold on. So, what's the deal with the Ajilenakh Nuts? Other than the bad Cyno jokes...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Hahaha, we'll get to that. But first, introductions are in order! This is Djer — a member of the Temple of Silence.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: #And you remember {NICKNAME}, right, Djer?

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Of course. I'd never forget a participant in the Rite of Duels or the hero who saved Sumeru.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Awesome. Could you go over what happened to you one more time, Djer? Our valiant hero is gonna help us get to the bottom of this.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh? I am?

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Might as well join since you're here, am I right?

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Just hear him out. You're gonna want to uncover this mystery once you do — I'd bet on it.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Well, I was on an expedition in the desert not too long ago when I got caught in some quicksand.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Later, it became obvious it wasn't normal quicksand, because instead of sinking to my death, I fell into an undiscovered ruin.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: In my panic, arms and legs flailing about, I suspect I touched some things I shouldn't have...

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: ...Because in that brief moment, an enormous amount of information came surging into my mind.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: I would hesitate to even call it knowledge because my brain had no capacity to process the information.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: To use an analogy, it would be like... Trying to stuff thousands of Ajilenakh Nuts into a small water skin without it bursting.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Sorry, sorry. Again with the Ajilenakh Nuts, I know..

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: It's fine. We're getting to that part of the story, anyway.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: *sigh* True.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Well, just as I was on the verge of madness, a single phrase broke through the storm of thoughts in my head...

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: It was a man's voice saying, "don't eat Ajilenakh Nuts."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: I know it's hard to believe, but that's what happened. I was saved by the phrase "don't eat Ajilenakh Nuts."

choices.text: You mentioned a man's voice...

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: I'm not sure.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: I'm not even certain it was a man's voice... It's hard to remember now that I've been repeating it so much myself.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Anyway, the good news is, I no longer feel like my head is going to explode.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Of course, the bad news is, that phrase has been stuck in my head for the past few days.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, but doesn't that have the opposite effect? Like, the more you say "don't eat it," the more you want to eat it...

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Yes, that's exactly right!

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Whoever the voice belongs to, I don't know what his deal is with those nuts...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Well, the world's a big place. There's bound to be people who don't like sweet stuff.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: I suppose. Strangely enough... I'm starting to think the voice belonged not to a man, but a cat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A cat? How?

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: That's the question, isn't it. What would a cat be doing in an abandoned ruin like that?

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Just as my mind was reaching its breaking point, I could've sworn I heard the sound of a cat guiding me to exit.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: But when I came to, all I saw was endless desert, and Sethos shaking me in a desperate attempt to wake me up.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: I'll admit, it was pretty terrifying, seeing you like that — staring off into space and mumbling about Ajilenakh Nuts... Heh.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You sure don't sound terrified!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Sorry, sorry, sorry. It's not that I don't care. It's just... kind of hard for rambling about Ajilenakh Nuts to sound menacing.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Now, what Layla was saying, on the other hand... That is much creepier.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You mean about the number of moons?

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Exactly. The unknown is what breeds fear. Ajilenakh Nuts are familiar, but the moon suspended above us at night... That's about as foreign as it gets.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: W—We don't know that for sure! There could be a whole other world inside an Ajilenakh Nut, with a moon of its own!

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Huh... I guess.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Ajilenakh Nuts are not to be underestimated...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Right, yeah! Of course! Won't catch me disparaging the mighty Ajilenakh Nut. No sir...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so a similar thing happened to Layla, then?

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Yeah, I think so.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: I was in a hurry to rescue Djer, so I put a marker on the incident site so we could go back and investigate.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: When his condition stabilized, we doubled back around to check, and—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You discovered Layla in a similar condition.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Exactly.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Multiple victims with the same symptoms at the same location... It wasn't hard to conclude that something is seriously wrong with that place.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: So, after we got Layla out of there, I had the Temple of Silence put up a warning sign at the scene and send patrols to watch the area.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Speaking of, Cyno, Tighnari, and I are going to head back there and investigate once Layla is stable... So, as per usual, you're here just in time!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, it sounds like you need all the help you can get.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: That's for sure. But, there's another reason I want Cyno and Tighnari involved in this.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Because the story doesn't end there. Right, Djer?

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Hm... Oh, yes. Where was I? The Ajilenakh Nuts butted in and I... Right. Yes. The cat.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: As I followed the cat noises, the voice said something else: "So, there are those from Tulaytullah who still endure..."

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: I thought that was strange, of course, because well... Was the voice referring to me?

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Haha, records of my ancestry are rather sparse, so I'm not sure if my bloodline even traces back to that place.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Tulaytullah...

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: That's right. The Temple of Silence's place of origin.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: And the home of Tighnari's people. Plus, Hermanubis, who Cyno and I both share a connection to, was one of the city's founders.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: As the Temple's current leader, if something strange happens in the desert, it's my job to get to the bottom of it.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: But, it turns out, a lot of people have a horse in this race, and I'm not leaving any of them out.

choices.text: Good idea.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: See? Knew you'd join.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: But yeah, that's all we know about Djer's situation.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Tighnari should be done on his end. Let's head back and check on Miss Layla.

choices.text: Count me in, too.
Do you know who it was?
Yeah, that's one nutty idea that's not all it's... cracked up to be.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Oh, dear... another master of puns?

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: One of Cyno's card buddies, actually.

response.speaker: Djer
response.text: Ah, I think I might just take that as my cue to head back to the desert...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: How are you feeling? Ah, but don't speak if it's too taxing.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: It's fine. I'm much better now, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I feel like I haven't slept in two days... So, pretty much back to normal...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa... That's your normal!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Layla...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: #Ah, {NICKNAME}, Paimon... I thought I heard your voices earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Oh, and, um... I'm sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You don't have to apologize! You didn't do anything wrong!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Ah... No, I just mean... I think I'm about to disappoint you.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: My head was kinda muddled earlier, but I still heard your conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I know you're trying to figure out what happened to me, and I want to help...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: But... I really don't remember anything.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Does your head still hurt?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: No, I feel fine. The incense you made helped a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I'm still hearing those words in my head, but other than that, I'm okay.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: It's just... all I remember are those words. Everything else is a total blank.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: One moment I was heading to the stargazing point I'd calculated, and the next, I was on my back in the sand, the same phrase playing over and over again in my mind...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: How many moons are there in the sky?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Sethos, did your friend Djer suffer from memory loss too?

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Not really. His memories are blurry, but there aren't huge gaps like this.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: He remembers touching something, someone talking, a voice mentioning "Tulaytullah," and hearing a cat lead him to the exit.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Ah! A cat...

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Did you hear it too?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Huh, now that you mention it, I think so? It was so soft, I thought I was imagining things...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Hmm... Which means, at the very least, what the two of you experienced while escaping the ruin is consistent.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: A single sentence repeating in your heads, and the faint sound of a cat.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Still not a lot to go off of.

dialogues.speaker: Sethos
dialogues.text: Agreed.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, is your head hurting again, Layla?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: *breathe in*

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: *breathe out* No, I was just thinking... Maybe my memories are blank because I was sleepwalking at the time?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Sometimes, my friends and classmates tell me about things I don't remember doing, or places I don't remember going.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I don't talk about it a lot because, well... I don't even know how it happens. But I don't want my personal circumstances clouding your judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: So, I... just wanted to mention that.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Ah... I see. Well, thank you for telling us.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: But, I don't think we need to dwell on that for now. We're gonna check out the site of the incident for ourselves, so that should help us come to our own conclusions.

choices.text: I'm with Tighnari.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: O—Okay...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Then, could I come too? I have to know what happened to me back there.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Sure, but on one condition — you need to be in tip-top shape before we head out.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: If your condition isn't stable enough before then, we'll have to figure out something else.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: O—Of course! No problem!

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Well, I'm more concerned about Tighnari... You sure you'll be alright in the desert?

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: You say that like I'll evaporate on first contact with sand or something.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Call it... curiosity. If this concerns my ancestors, I want to figure out what's going on.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Anyway, as long as I take things slow when the sun's out, I should be fine with the right preparation.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Besides, it's a good idea to have a doctor on hand in case of emergencies.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: So long as our doctor doesn't become the emergency.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Well, if that happens, I suppose I'll just have to rely on the kindness of my entourage to haul me back home.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Alright, well, that all sounds good to me. Let's meet in two days like we agreed.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Sethos finds a map and marks the location for you.

response.speaker: Sethos
response.text: Djer and I are gonna head back to the Temple of Silence and do some research in the meantime. See you in a couple days!

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Sounds good.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: What about you, Layla? If you feel like you need more rest, I can arrange a room for you to stay in.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: O—Oh, um, no need! I've asked enough of you as it is...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Besides, I feel a lot better. I should make it back to my dorm, no problem.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You sure? Don't push it too hard, or you might end up sleepwalking along the way...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Don't worry. I'll be fine.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: I have other things I need to do, anyway. Like letting my advisor and classmates know that I'm fine, adjusting my stargazing schedule, things like that...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: If I don't get it all done, I doubt I'll be able to sit still, let alone stay here and get some rest...

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: I'm not so sure that's—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You know what? I'll make sure she gets back.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Ah, a much better idea. Thank you, Traveler.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Of course, if anything starts to feel off, come back for a checkup right away!

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: You'd better listen to him, Layla, or he'll feed you tasteless slop as a punishment.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Punishment? You're the one who caught a cold. You're supposed to eat light when that happens.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Besides, with your nose stuffed up like that, you couldn't taste anything to begin with.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Huh, is that so.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: And here I thought it was an intaste-tinal issue.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: ...Should've seen that coming. You're off the clock, so now it's time for puns, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh brother, not this again...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Don't worry, Paimon. I understand. If you want me to stop, then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—Then...?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: You'll have to call a plumber. Tell them someone's gotta "pipe" down...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... This is getting more insufferable by the second!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Put a sock in it already. Please...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got it, Paimon, one "sock-in" coming right up~

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Paimon's done with this game...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You win, okay? Let's just get out of here... please.

choices.text: Okay, bye, everyone. I'll keep Layla safe.

response.speaker: Tighnari
response.text: Alright. You stay safe... I'll try to stay sane.

choices.text: And Paimon mentally sound.
Don't put too much pressure on yourself, Layla.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Moons... Ajilenakh Nuts...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Moons... Ajilenakh Nuts...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are the moons going... nuts?

choices.text: Paimon, please. Enough repeating...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no, looks like Paimon's caught the brain bug too — she can't stop thinking about those two things!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's gotta clear her head. But how...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Aha! Got it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The cafe over there! Why don't we head over for a quick pick-me-up?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Hmm?)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Something's up with Layla...)

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: S—Sorry. I feel kinda tired all of a sudden...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, is it because of all Paimon's muttering just now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, sorry, sorry... Um, the coffee will be Paimon's treat, okay?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So generous all of a sudden...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, you make it sound like Paimon's stingy or something!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, well, she'll just have to show you her... true colors! Yeah, starting now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #You sit tight and take care of Layla, {NICKNAME}. Paimon's gonna get us some snacks and coffee!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Be right back! Don't go anywhere in the meantime!

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: *sigh*... She's pushing herself again, as always.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Other Layla, I presume?

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Saw right through me, huh...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: I apologize for the sudden emergence, but I didn't have any other options...

choices.text: It's fine.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Well, that's true...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: So, for "our" sake — and your safety — allow me to fill in the gaps in her memory.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I knew it. You were in control when it happened...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: That's right.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Layla was already in bad shape, stressing about her new study topic, focusing on the stars instead of her surroundings...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: By the time she realized the danger she was in, it was too late...

choices.text: As far as I'm concerned, you're Layla as well.
You're putting me to sleep over here...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: #It seems your jokes have improved with practice, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Happy about that?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Absolutely. Finally, someone to share the load.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: ...Ah, you know what? Collei's helping out the Akademiya, but I haven't had the chance to check on her. Why don't you do me a favor, and... go do that.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Hold on, I thought you were having me over for dinner?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Ah!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Quicksand near the ideal viewing spot? Wasn't expecting that...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Looks like Layla's been under a lot of pressure lately. She hasn't been paying attention to her surroundings...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (But... why would quicksand lead to a place like this?)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Well, all in all, looks like a common desert ruin... Guess there's nothing to do but try to find a way out.)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Oh, Layla... What have you gotten yourself into this time...)

dialogues.speaker: Djer
dialogues.text: There are records in the Temple of Silence that speak of the ancient desert peoples' love of raising cats. Perhaps I encountered some ancestral cat spirit, long since passed on?

talks.objective: Activate the device to open the door

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: How many moons are there in the sky?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: ("How many moons are there in the sky?")

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (How many moons are there in the sky?)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Okay. Information isn't rushing into my brain anymore. That's good.)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (How many moons are there in the sky?)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (My head hurts, but there are no more dark spots in my vision, and I can see in front of me. Still...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (How many moons are there in the sky?)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (What's going on? The same thought keeps popping into my head. What does it mean...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (How many moons are there in the sky?)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Isn't there... just one?)
Meow.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (...A cat? I think there was one earlier, too...)

dialogues.speaker: "Cat"
dialogues.text: Meow... Meow...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (I'm not hearing things — it really is a cat! But what is it doing here...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (How many moons... are there... No. Stop it!)

dialogues.speaker: "Cat"
dialogues.text: Meow.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Does it want me to follow its cries?)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Well, it's not like I've got other options. Come on, Layla. You can do this...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Ugh...

talks.objective: Follow the cat's guidance to leave the ruins

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, and Kaveh, your coffee beans... You were too busy glaring at Alhaitham, you almost forgot them.

dialogues.speaker: Mehrak
dialogues.text: Beep-boop~! Beep-boop~!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Well, we're pretty close to the Akademiya now. I should be fine from here.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Thanks for the coffee, Paimon. I feel much better now!

choices.text: Coffee's great and all...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Right. I'll follow the doctor's orders... Or try to, at least...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: With the blessing of the stars, I hope we all get a good night's sleep.

choices.text: But, you need sleep too, Layla.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: ...And so, I followed the cat's cries to find my way out.

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: It was quite a kind creature... It didn't even leave until the other me started to wake up.

choices.text: Well, that fills in the gaps...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Thinking back, it all started when I touched that device.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: I've heard fellow students talk about it before... how the desert is full of objects that do strange things.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Sometimes, it's just a minor inconvenience. But, other times, devices like that can cause massive trouble.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I know exactly what you mean.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Ah, of course. I forgot how much adventuring experience you have.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Still, carrying an umbrella doesn't mean you can't get soaked, so just... Be careful, and stay away from unknown devices.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thanks for the advice.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: No need to thank me. You and Layla are about to head into dangerous territory together. You need to be safe, so she can be safe.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Well, I think that about sums it up.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Ah, and just in time — your coffee's here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! A little help over here!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Seeing Paimon precariously try to keep her balance, you rush over to help her out.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: When you turn around, Layla is rubbing her eyes sleepily.

choices.text: Sounds very similar to what happened to Djer.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Something strange is going on...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (I think this door can be opened using the device next to it...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Just like I thought.)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Ugh! What was that! My head... it hurts...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (Is Layla... waking up? ...No, that's not it...!)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (What... What's going on... It's... too much.)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (...I don't... understand...)

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: (The ground is... where am I? It's... spinning...)
